title: dirac-backprop-code: numerical test for "Backpropagation as Dirac-bracket dynamics of dissipative training"
description: Code for the numerical test (Sec. IV) of N. L. Holanda and I. E. Cunha, Backpropagation as Dirac-bracket dynamics of dissipative training. It checks, at random points of the constraint surface, that the Dirac bracket of the layer constraints reproduces backpropagation, and trains a network by integrating the Dirac flow.
